candidate_relations.reason: Mild restriction with a normal HRCT is not idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
Sézary syndrome requires erythroderma and blood involvement; this is papular CD8-positive granulomatous CTCL.
Arthritis plus restriction could suggest RA-ILD, but the defining disease is CD8-positive granulomatous CTCL, not RA.
Sarcoidosis is a granulomatous differential but does not explain a clonal CD8-positive atypical lymphocytic infiltrate in skin and marrow.
Adult-onset Still disease is a systemic autoinflammatory illness, not this lymphoma.
Mild restrictive physiology is a pulmonary manifestation, not the lymphoma.
Rheumatologic serologies were unremarkable; this is not SLE.
Lymphomatoid papulosis is a CD30-positive lymphoproliferative disease, not this granulomatous CD8 CTCL.
Psoriatic arthritis does not produce clonal cutaneous T-cell infiltrates.
Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is the parent family missing CD8-positive granulomatous specificity.
Mycosis fungoides is usually CD4-positive epidermotropic CTCL, an incompatible subtype versus CD8-positive granulomatous CTCL.
Pseudolymphoma conflicts with matching clonal TCR rearrangements in three skin biopsies and marrow.
Cutaneous lymphoma is a broader parent missing lineage and granulomatous CD8 phenotype.
A pseudolymphomatous reaction likewise conflicts with documented clonality and marrow involvement.
Lymphoma is a generic parent of the reference.
Polyarthritis is a rheumatologic manifestation of the lymphoma, not rheumatoid arthritis as the primary diagnosis.
Erythema elevatum diutinum is a neutrophilic vasculitis, not CTCL.
Granulomatous slack skin is a related granulomatous CTCL variant with pendulous folds, not this papular CD8-positive disease.

case_quality_flags: Clonal CD8-positive granulomatous cutaneous T-cell lymphoma with marrow involvement; no candidate includes the CD8-positive granulomatous phenotype.
